items.value: Random rubble masonry, RCC columns and RCC plinth beam
RCC columns, beams and slabs; 9-inch brick load-bearing walls; 4.5-inch brick partition walls
Zinc-alum roofing sheets; lunumidella timber ceiling with exposed rafters

Front door teak sash with teak or similar frame; internal doors engineered timber; windows powder-coated aluminium with 5 mm glass; mortise lock (Union or equivalent) on front door, knob locks on others
Fitted pantry cupboard with granite top, refrigerator, burner, built-in oven, hood and stainless steel sink
European-standard fittings, water closet and wash basin with four-piece accessories and European-standard faucets; walls tiled to ceiling; ceramic or porcelain floor tiles, waterproofed
Timber planks (teak or similar); steel and timber mixed handrail
Porcelain tiles (24x24 in and 12x12 in) on ground floor, terrace, balcony and veranda; 10 mm Merbau timber flooring in bedrooms
Internal: smooth plaster, two coats wall putty, filler and two coats emulsion (Dulux or equivalent); external: semi-rough plaster, filler and two coats weather-shield paint
12,000 Btu air conditioners in all bedrooms
UPVC cold water pipe network from a 1,000-litre overhead tank; hot water to bathrooms and pantry from independent 15-litre geysers
Zinc-alum gutters and down pipes with manholes and gullies, connected to main drain
Independent electricity and piped water connection for each house
Garden area turfed to the contour with interlocked pathways

notes: Brochure specification page used; Prime Lands web page gave a shorter summary (teak front door, mahogany internal doors) that differs slightly, brochure wording kept.
